_doc: Station-calibrated official-forecast sources. ENABLED sources are ingested live by the forecast availability lane (replacement_forecast_production._ingest_station_forecasts_live -> station_forecast_adapter.ingest_enabled_station_sources_live), routed by adapter_kind on each source's own poll_interval_seconds. Each source reaches its city's served center ONLY via the per-city source-clock scheme weight (DATA PRECISION, never a de-bias). Set enabled=false to drop a source from live ingest.

cwa_township.auth: env CWA_API_KEY (forecast-live plist) or gitignored config/cwa_secret.json — NEVER committed
cwa_township.notes: CWA 鄉鎮天氣預報 (F-D0047-063), Songshan district 松山區 which contains RCSS (Taipei-Songshan), the SAME station the Taipei market settles on (Wunderground RCSS METAR daily-max). Live ingestion and source-role authority are defined by this row and the source registry.

cwa_township_hourly_low.auth: env CWA_API_KEY (forecast-live plist) or gitignored config/cwa_secret.json — NEVER committed
cwa_township_hourly_low.notes: CWA F-D0047-061 complete official XML. This is a township-district hourly-sampled Temperature product, not a settlement-station forecast and not F-D0047-063 12-hour MinT. Only D+1 Asia/Taipei 00:00..23:00 with 24 unique finite whole-hour samples is persisted as LOW; DatasetInfo.Update is its publisher revision clock and local capture is the availability proof.

hko_fnd.notes: HKO Nine-Day Forecast (fnd). weatherForecast[].forecastMaxtemp.value and forecastMintemp.value degC, forecastDate YYYYMMDD. One issue is fetched once and persisted as distinct HIGH/LOW rows. updateTime is the issue/cycle clock.
